proposed_capability: Exact-build local BI-002 hunger certification on the operator-confirmed disposable session, subject to independent vanilla, measurement, and effect admission.
player_save_control_impact: Keep existing saves and installed mods intact. Any test effect requires fresh player, session, scene and save admission.
expected_outcome: Collect measured vanilla, modified and rollback rows when admitted and preserve a zero-row receipt if the vanilla setup cannot be verified.
negative_tests: Reject an enabled mod configuration as unverified vanilla
Exclude attempts without observed eating or measured lag
rollback_path: Discard unsaved trial progress only when needed and remove only an experiment-authored package if installed.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact vanilla hunger resource and Studio build
Vanilla isolation and source of numeric lag measurements
decision_rationale: The receipt scopes the local investigation and does not grant permission for game input or authorize a package with unverified provenance.
